entries.research_quote: This qualitative difference renders conclusions about the absolute importance
entries.source_quote: each sense is of crucial importance

rules.must_preserve: Keep the different functions of vision and touch and the conclusion that these differences do not establish one absolutely most important sense.
rules.allowed_changes: Replace abstract classifications with seeing a destination and feeling body position; split sentences without turning either sense into a universal winner.

entries.research_quote: maintenance of genetic biodiversity and offering habitat for species
entries.source_quote: provide shelter for birds and beneficial insects

rules.must_preserve: Keep habitat provision and biodiversity as a possible function of urban agriculture; the original review covers Global North projects, not a guaranteed benefit for every garden worldwide.
rules.allowed_changes: Explain habitat as a place for birds and beneficial insects; define biodiversity in plain words. Omit unrelated health and food-safety claims; retain possibility and the review scope.

entries.research_quote: associations were strongest for having a significant person admitted to the ICU

rules.must_preserve: Keep the stronger association of hospitalized or ICU COVID-19 in a significant person with respondents reporting severe depressive/anxiety symptoms. Describe group comparisons, not an increase within every person over time, clinical diagnosis or proven causation. Do not rank ICU above the deceased group.
rules.allowed_changes: Explain significant person as family or friend and ICU as intensive care. Omit numerical ratios and model details together; keep symptoms, observational limits and European study scope.

entries.research_quote: a positive correlation between ovariole number and aggression
entries.source_quote: We cannot say that ovarioles cause females to fight

rules.must_preserve: Keep the positive association across the eight studied fruit-fly species between ovariole number and headbutting aggression. A species pattern is not a prediction for every individual and does not show that ovarioles cause fighting.
rules.allowed_changes: Define ovarioles as egg-producing structures. Explain correlation as two features varying together; omit exact statistical coefficients without adding causal certainty or universal AI performance.
